description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ratmalana, Ratmalana D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 521003
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extent measurements, owner names and addresses, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content is focused on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification category.
